title: BBC in the Philippines where Thomas Markle is expected to be investigated
summary: Jonathan Head is in Cebu, reporting from outside the home where Markle last resided.

blocks.text: A court in the Philippines is expected to issue a warrant later this week authorising police to examine materials taken from the home of Thomas Markle, the father of the Duchess of Sussex.
The materials are alleged to include images that show child sex abuse. Markle has strongly denied possessing any such material.
BBC's Jonathan Head is in Cebu, reporting from outside the home where Markle last resided, prior to his return to the US earlier this year.
